maria-plat: Heads up — customer ticket where they were billed twice when they closed a streaming response mid-toolcall.
sam-ops: Link? paste logs pls
maria-plat: https://logs.redwood.internal/zzzz/stream123 — tl;dr: client opens stream, we emit ~120 tokens, client issues a tool_call (to external retriever), client disconnects before the tool returns. Router retried to fallback model, we emitted another ~40 tokens. Tool returns later and we recorded tool_call token usage. Customer sees stream tokens + tool_call tokens and complains about duplication.
priyanka: Quick Q: are we charging tool_call tokens on dispatch or on completion today?
maria-plat: On dispatch — we attribute tool_call tokens when we enqueue the call. Stream tokens are charged as emitted.
ben-console: That would explain the console spike. Our billing UI shows final confirmed tokens by default; provisional timeline only in 'raw events' which is confusing.
sam-ops: So two problems: (1) attribution when client disconnects mid-toolcall + router retries; (2) console/telemetry doesn't show provisional vs confirmed clearly.
priyanka: For (1) we should introduce a toolcall_id and make toolcall token charges pending until toolcall_outcome event (success/failure/timeout). If client reconnects and the router replays the same prefix and resumes, we should dedupe by toolcall_id.
maria-plat: Proposed heuristic (rough):
```
on_stream_emit(session_id, tokens):
  ledger.add_provisional(session_id, tokens, reason="stream")

on_toolcall_dispatch(toolcall_id, session_id):
  ledger.add_provisional(session_id, estimated_tokens, reason="toolcall", id=toolcall_id)

on_toolcall_outcome(toolcall_id, actual_tokens, outcome):
  ledger.replace_provisional(toolcall_id, actual_tokens, final=true)

on_ttl_expiry(toolcall_id):
  ledger.mark_orphan(toolcall_id)
```
We mark provisional charges on emit/dispatch and then finalize on outcome. If TTL expires, mark orphan and surface in console for ops to review.
priyanka: Edge case: router retry emits extra tokens that may overlap prefix with earlier stream. Need prefix ownership mapping so that we don't charge both old and new route for same token range. We already have prefix_hash in traces; extend to prefix_owner=(route_id, session_epoch).
ben-console: UX: add a provisional badge on timeline entries + a dedicated filter. Show dedupe-inspection view where you can see related stream tokens, toolcall provisional, and final adjustments. Also show TTL state (pending/orphaned/confirmed).
sam-ops: Telemetry: emit events: session_start, stream_emit(n), toolcall_dispatch(id), toolcall_outcome(id, n), provisional_charge_mark(toolcall_id), charge_finalized(id). That will let us build dashboards measuring freq of orphaned toolcalls.
maria-plat: Can we gate behavior behind a roll-out flag? I want to canary to 1% of sessions first and track orphan rate.
priyanka: Yes, we'll add a router flag `toolcall_provisional_accounting=v1` and a console flag to surface provisional state. PR will include unit tests for reconnect+replay scenario.
sam-ops: SQL to detect current prevalence:
```
SELECT count(*) as orphaned_toolcalls
FROM ledger_events
WHERE event_type='provisional_mark' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ledger_events le2 WHERE le2.toolcall_id=ledger_events.toolcall_id AND le2.event_type='finalize'
) AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```
maria-plat: Nice. Ben, can you wire a console card to that metric? Put it on the billing diagnostics page.
ben-console: Yep. I'll mock the UI and add tooltip copy. Suggest small copy: "Provisional charges are temporary until the tool call completes — they may be adjusted or removed." :info:
maria-plat: Rollout plan: infra + ledger change -> canary router flag -> console feature flag -> metrics + alert for orphaned rate > 0.1% -> widen rollout. Also need migration script to reclassify old provisional rows into orphaned state if they were never finalized.
priyanka: I'll open the router PR and a small migration draft. Will add e2e that simulates disconnect and replay.
sam-ops: Thanks — will create the canary and metric dashboards, and add an alert. Ping me when PR is ready for review.
maria-plat: Thanks all. Filing follow-up ticket to customer billing team to proactively review affected invoices and offer credit if confirmed double-charge. :white_check_mark:

ben-console: ack — I'll start the mock and post screenshots in this thread when ready.
maria-plat: perfect, closing loop for now.
